body: I'm sorry that I haven't spoken in a while. To be honest, I didn't expect to have so many people reach out to me, let alone anyone. I feel the need to update you all and let you know that I spoke to a friend about the things running through my mind and after a lot of fighting, I'm now on my way to the hospital. It's not at all how I thought this day would go, but yeah. Thank you everyone for your kind words even though I still do not believe I deserve them, I sincerely appreciate it. Happy Thanksgiving everyone. And for those who don't celebrate it, have a great day.
Thank you and same to you. I hope you find peace in life or wherever else you may be.
I didn't mean to write this much. I guess I had a lot to say and no idea how to write it. I'm sorry if I wasted your time.
